killall -9 -q code code-insiders 2>/dev/null || true; python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os
p = '/home/user/.config/Code/User/keybindings.json'
entry = {'command': 'workbench.action.terminal.toggleTerminal', 'key': 'ctrl+k'}
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
try:
    data = json.load(open(p)) if os.path.exists(p) else []
except Exception:
    data = []
if not isinstance(data, list):
    data = []
data = [x for x in data if not (isinstance(x, dict) and x.get('key') == entry.get('key'))]
data.append(entry)
with open(p, 'w') as f:
    json.dump(data, f)
PY
